notes: SOURCE PROPERTY THIS BRIEF DID NOT ANTICIPATE: this filer did NOT use the county's Form A / Form B at all. Pages 2 and 3 are his OWN PORTRAIT SPREADSHEET print-outs - no 'Form A'/'Form B' banner, no printed column-header row, no Address column, and a filer-typed 'Total' row instead of the form's 'Total Contributions: (to line 1 of report)' line. They are still schedules and they still close: each sheet's own Total equals the matching This-Report cell on the county cover (p1). PAGE ORDER IS NOT FORM ORDER: the EXPENDITURES sheet is p2 and the CONTRIBUTIONS sheet is p3. Column order also differs from the county form - expenditures run Date | Payee | Purpose | City | Amount, contributions run Date | Name | City | Amount. Because the contributions sheet has NO state column, donor_state is honestly BLANK on 23 of 24 rows (left unwritten by the FILER, not redacted by anyone); the one exception is row 14, where the filer wrote 'Dyke Va' inside the city cell. The cover (p1) is the 2026 typed form, carries the clerk's pink RECEIVED MAY 22 2026 stamp - the only 2026 filing in this set with one - is signed and dated 5-22-2026, and has the candidate's street address, City/Zip AND home/office phone BLACKED OUT BY THE COUNTY (government-applied redaction, preserved). This is a SCANNED document, not a Polimorphic e-filing: no text layer at all over the three pages and no Polimorphic footer. No per-page subtotal, no in-kind row; the one negative figure is the cover's parenthesised This-Report balance (5,429.04), a real overspend and not repaired.
